visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a straw hat and a pink dress, is outdoors eating a sugar-coated donut. (2) A shot of the 'Leonard's Bakery' storefront shows a red and white striped awning and a large neon sign. Several people are visible in line under bright natural daylight. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a pink box with 'Leonard's Bakery' branding. A hand opens the box to reveal six sugar-dusted malasadas with different fillings. (4) The woman is shown in a medium shot, splitting open a malasada to reveal a thick, yellow custard filling. She smiles and takes a bite while sitting outdoors. (5) A close-up shows hands splitting another malasada, this time revealing a dark, liquid chocolate filling. The lighting is bright and natural. (6) The woman continues to eat and talk to the camera, gesturing with her hands. She splits a third malasada showing a white coconut filling. The setting remains consistent with a park background. (7) The video concludes with the woman giving a rating, gesturing 'okay' with her hand, followed by a final shot of the bakery sign from a moving car perspective.
